units.source_text: 太吉郎在内客厅里同一位客人对饮祭神酒。

en.t: Taikichiro was in the inner parlor, sharing sacred festival sake with a guest.

units.source_text: 其实谈不上是喝酒，只不过是陪陪客人罢了。

en.t: In truth, it could hardly be called drinking; he was merely keeping the guest company.

units.source_text: 阿繁不时站起来忙着侍候。

en.t: Oshige kept getting up from time to time, busily attending to them.
